name: Voxmat Path Tracer
definition: A real-time path tracer for per-voxel PBR and global illumination, implemented in GLSL fragment shaders. It renders voxel models defined by 3D textures, supporting emission, metallic/roughness, transmission, and refraction.
summary: Voxmat Path Tracer is a real-time per-voxel PBR path tracer that distinguishes itself by performing full path tracing on a per-voxel basis using a pre-computed irradiance cache for indirect diffuse lighting.
